name: Warrior Surf Camp
description_short: A week-long surf day camp at Rexhame Beach in Marshfield, MA, for ages 7–12. Campers surf every day when conditions allow and do beach games and beach cleanups while waiting for waves. Sessions run 4 hours, and the start time depends on the tide.
refund_policy_summary: The 10% deposit is non-refundable. Cancel 60 or more days before the session starts for a 90% refund, or 30–59 days before for a 50% refund. There are no refunds within 30 days of the session, during it, or for missed days. Everything is refunded if the camp cancels for public health reasons. You can switch sessions free of charge if space allows.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers surf daily in the ocean at Rexhame Beach, staying out as long as conditions allow. Session times are set by the tide.
